source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 5 (PDF 126-152), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Data Analytics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Model building is the process of:
(Model building kis amal (process) ko kehte hain?)

options.text: masle ki har tafseel bina kuch chhore likhna
sirf raw data ke charts banana
mushkil masail ki saada shakal banana
data ko spreadsheet mein mehfooz karna

blocks.explanation: Model building mushkil masail ki saada shakal (simplified representation) banane ka amal hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Model building is the process of creating simplified representations of complex problems

blocks.prompt:
2 Model building helps to solve real-world issues by focusing on:
(Model building asal duniya ke masail hal karne mein kis cheez par tawajjuh de kar madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Model building aham hisson (key elements) par tawajjuh de kar asal masail samajhne aur hal karne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps in understanding, analyzing, and solving real-world issues by focusing on key elements

blocks.prompt:
3 In simple terms, a model is:
(Saada alfaaz mein model kya hai?)

options.text: asal surat-e-haal ki har tafseel ke sath hoo-ba-hoo naqal
mushkil masle ko saada tareeqe se dekhne ka zariya
data mehfooz karne wala computer program

blocks.explanation: Model kisi mushkil masle ya surat-e-haal ko saada tareeqe se dekhne ka zariya hai; yeh cheezon ko samajhne, wazeh karne ya un ki peshgoi (prediction) mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: a model is a simplified way of looking at a complex problem or situation

blocks.prompt:
4 The chapter compares a model with a map of a city because both:
(Chapter model ko shehar ke naqshe (map) se kyon milata hai?)

options.text: dono aham hisse dikhate aur ghair zaroori tafseel chhor dete hain
dono shehar ki har imarat aur har shakhs dikhate hain
dono sirf computer par bante hain
dono se kuch samjha nahin ja sakta

blocks.explanation: Naqsha sirf sarakain aur nishaniyan dikhata hai; isi tarah model sab se aham hisson par tawajjuh deta hai aur ghair zaroori tafseel chhor deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Just like a map helps someone navigate a city by showing roads and landmarks

blocks.prompt:
5 A student's study plan that focuses on important subjects and ignores less relevant tasks is an example of:
(Talib-e-ilm ka study plan jo aham subjects par tawajjuh de aur kam zaroori kaam chhor de, kis cheez ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Study plan aham subjects rakh kar schedule ko saada banata hai, is liye chapter ise model kehta hai.

book_ref.quote: This plan is a model that simplifies their schedule by focusing on important subjects

blocks.prompt:
6 In decision making, models are especially important because they:
(Faisla karne (decision making) mein model khaas tor par kyon aham hain?)

options.text: data ki zaroorat khatam kar dete hain
hamesha bilkul durust jawab dete hain
maloomat ko aur mushkil bana dete hain
faisle se pehle mukhtalif nataij par ghaur karne mein madad dete hain

blocks.explanation: Model masle par munazzam (structured) tareeqe se sochne deta hai aur faisle se pehle mukhtalif nataij (outcomes) par ghaur karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: where models help us consider different outcomes before making a choice

blocks.prompt:
7 In the chapter's farming example, the model studies which two things to predict the right planting time?
(Chapter ki kheti wali misaal mein model kin do cheezon ko parh kar fasal lagane ka sahi waqt batata hai?)

options.text: mausam ke patterns aur mitti ki halat
fasal ki qeematain aur bank qarz
parhai ke ghante aur exam marks

blocks.explanation: Kisan ka model mausam ke patterns aur mitti ki halat (soil conditions) dekhta hai, jis se achhi fasal ka imkaan barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: By studying weather patterns and soil conditions, the model helps the farmer predict the right planting time

blocks.prompt:
8 Which data do meteorologists collect and analyse with models to forecast the weather?
(Meteorologists (mausam ke mahireen) mausam ki peshgoi ke liye kaun sa data jama karte hain?)

options.text: stock prices aur customers ka rawayya
temperature, humidity (nami) aur hawa ki raftaar

blocks.explanation: Weather forecasting mein meteorologists temperature, humidity (nami) aur hawa ki raftaar jama karte hain, phir model se peshgoi karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Meteorologists collect data such as temperature, humidity, and wind speed

blocks.prompt:
9 In financial predictions, banks and companies use models to predict all of the following EXCEPT:
(Financial predictions mein banks aur companies model se in sab ki peshgoi karte hain SIWAYE:)

options.text: fasal lagane ke liye mitti ki halat

blocks.explanation: Banks aur companies economic trends, stock prices aur customers ke rawayye ki peshgoi karte hain; mitti ki halat kheti wali misaal hai.

book_ref.quote: Banks and companies use models to predict economic trends, stock prices, and even customer behavior

blocks.prompt:
10 In scientific research, models help scientists to:
(Scientific research mein model scientists ki kis kaam mein madad karte hain?)

options.text: har experiment ki jagah survey karna
theories test karna, naye khayalat dhoondna aur peshgoi karna

blocks.explanation: Model scientists ko theories test karne, naye khayalat dhoondne aur data par mabni peshgoi karne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: In scientific research, models help scientists test theories, explore new ideas, and make predictions based on data

blocks.prompt:
11 Models have become more powerful and accurate in analysing large amounts of data because of advances in:
(Bare data ke tajziye mein model kin cheezon ki taraqqi ki wajah se zyada taqatwar aur durust ho gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Machine Learning (ML) aur Artificial Intelligence (AI) ki taraqqi se model zyada taqatwar aur durust ho gaye hain.

book_ref.quote: models have become even more powerful and accurate in analyzing large amounts of data

blocks.prompt:
12 Statistics is a branch of:
(Statistics kis ilm ki shakh (branch) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Statistics mathematics ki shakh hai jo data samajhne aur us ka tajziya karne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Statistics is a branch of mathematics that helps us understand and analyze data

blocks.prompt:
13 Which of the following is NOT one of the basic statistical concepts listed in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa chapter mein di gayi basic statistical concepts mein shamil NAHIN?)
blocks.explanation: Basic statistical concepts descriptive statistics, central tendency, dispersion aur probability hain; data cleaning data ki tayyari ka qadam hai.

book_ref.quote: Some basic statistical concepts are descriptive statistics, measures of central tendency, measures of dispersion, and probability

blocks.text: 5.2.1 Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)

blocks.prompt:
14 The three main measures of central tendency are:
(Central tendency (markazi rujhan) ke teen bare paimane kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mean, median aur mode central tendency ke teen bare paimane hain.

book_ref.quote: There are three main measures of central tendency: mean, median, and mode

blocks.prompt:
15 The mean of 12, 15, 18, 21 and 24 is:
(12, 15, 18, 21 aur 24 ka mean kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab values jama karke tadaad se taqseem karein: 90/5 = 18.

book_ref.quote: To find the mean, we add all the numbers together and divide by the total number of values

blocks.prompt:
16 The median of 34, 18, 27, 45 and 22 is:
(34, 18, 27, 45 aur 22 ka median kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle tarteeb dein: 18, 22, 27, 34, 45. Values taaq (odd) hain, is liye beech wala number 27 median hai. (29.2 mean hai.)

book_ref.quote: If there is an odd number of values, the median is the exact middle number

blocks.prompt:
17 The median of the scores 40, 55, 65 and 80 is:
(Scores 40, 55, 65 aur 80 ka median kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Values juft (even) hain, is liye do beech wale numbers ka average median hai: (55 + 65)/2 = 60.

book_ref.quote: If there is an even number of values, the median is the average of the two middle numbers

blocks.prompt:
18 The mode of 4, 7, 7, 9, 12, 7, 9 is:
(4, 7, 7, 9, 12, 7, 9 ka mode kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 7 teen dafa aata hai, baqi sab se zyada, is liye mode 7 hai.

book_ref.quote: The mode is the number that appears most often in a data set

blocks.explanation: 20 aur 30 dono do do dafa aate hain (sab se zyada frequency), is liye do modes hain.

book_ref.quote: There can be more than one mode if multiple numbers appear with the same highest frequency

blocks.prompt:
20 Which measure tells us the middle point of data arranged in order?
(Tarteeb diye gaye data ka darmiyani nuqta kaun sa paimana batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Median tarteeb diye gaye numbers ki beech wali value hai; yeh data ka darmiyani nuqta batata hai.

book_ref.quote: The median helps us understand the middle point of the data

blocks.prompt:
21 Descriptive statistics are used to:
(Descriptive statistics kis kaam aati hain?)

options.text: customers se naya data jama karna
peshgoi ke talib-e-ilm pass hoga ya nahin

blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics data ka khulasa (summary) aur tarteeb dete hain aur poori tasveer dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Descriptive statistics are used to summarize and organize data

blocks.prompt:
22 The main benefit of descriptive statistics is that they:
(Descriptive statistics ka bara faida kya hai?)

options.text: har value alag alag dikhati hain
har value dekhe baghair poori tasveer dikhati hain
data ki sab ghaltiyan hata deti hain
mustaqbil ki values bilkul theek batati hain

blocks.explanation: Har aik value alag dekhne ke bajaye descriptive statistics poori tasveer dikha deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Instead of looking at every individual piece of data, descriptive statistics give us a way to see the overall picture

blocks.prompt:
23 The math scores of ten students are 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 and 88. Their mean is:
(Das talaba ke math scores 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 aur 88 hain. Un ka mean kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Das scores ka jama 758 hai, is liye mean 758/10 = 75.8 hai (kitab ki durust ki gayi value). 77.5 median hoga.

book_ref.quote: These simple calculations give us a quick summary of how the students performed

blocks.prompt:
24 Measures of dispersion tell us:
(Measures of dispersion (phelao ke paimane) kya batate hain?)

options.text: sab se zyada aane wali value

blocks.explanation: Dispersion ke paimane batate hain ke data kitna phela hua (spread out) hai, yani values mean ke qareeb hain ya door.

book_ref.quote: Measures of dispersion tell us how spread out or scattered the data is

blocks.prompt:
25 Two common measures of dispersion are:
(Dispersion ke do aam paimane kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Variance aur standard deviation dispersion ke do aam paimane hain.

book_ref.quote: Two common measures of dispersion are variance and standard deviation

blocks.prompt:
26 A lower variance means that the numbers in a data set are:
(Kam variance ka matlab hai ke data ke numbers:)
blocks.explanation: Zyada variance ka matlab numbers zyada phele hue; kam variance ka matlab numbers mean ke qareeb hain.

book_ref.quote: while a lower variance means that the numbers are closer to the mean

blocks.prompt:
27 Using σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)², the variance of 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 is:
(σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)² se 2, 4, 6, 8 aur 10 ka variance kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: μ = 6. Deviations ke square: 16, 4, 0, 4, 16; jama 40, aur 40/5 = 8. 6 mean hai aur 2.83 standard deviation.

book_ref.quote: The variance shows how much the numbers in a data set differ from the mean

blocks.prompt:
28 In the variance formula σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)², the symbol μ stands for:
(Variance ke formula mein μ kis cheez ki alamat hai?)
blocks.explanation: xᵢ har value hai, μ data set ka mean hai aur N values ki kul tadaad hai.

book_ref.quote: xᵢ represents each individual value in the data set, μ is the mean

blocks.prompt:
29 If the variance of a data set is 49, its standard deviation is:
(Agar data ka variance 49 ho to standard deviation kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Standard deviation variance ka square root hai: √49 = 7.

book_ref.quote: The standard deviation is simply the square root of the variance

blocks.prompt:
30 Class A has a variance of 12.56 and Class B a variance of 454 on the same exam. This shows that:
(Class A ka variance 12.56 aur Class B ka 454 hai. Is se kya pata chalta hai?)

options.text: Class A ke scores zyada phele hue hain
dono classes ka phelao barabar hai
Class B ke scores Class A se kahin zyada phele hue hain
sirf Class B ka mean zyada hai

blocks.explanation: Class B ka variance bohat zyada hai, is liye us ke scores zyada phele hue hain; Class A ke scores mean ke qareeb hain.

book_ref.quote: This confirms that Class B has a much higher variance

blocks.prompt:
31 The variance of Class A's scores (50, 52, 55, 57, 60) is 12.56. Its standard deviation is about:
(Class A ke scores ka variance 12.56 hai. Standard deviation taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Standard deviation = √12.56 ≈ 3.54 (kitab ki durusti: 3.55 nahin).

book_ref.quote: It tells us how spread out the numbers are in relation to the mean

blocks.prompt:
32 Probability is the study of:
(Probability (imkaan) kis cheez ka mutaala hai?)

options.text: koi waqiya hone ka kitna imkaan hai

blocks.explanation: Probability yeh batati hai ke koi waqiya hone ka kitna imkaan hai; yeh nataij ki peshgoi mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Probability is the study of how likely an event is to happen

blocks.prompt:
33 When a fair coin is flipped, the probability of getting tails is:
(Sikka (coin) uchhalne par tails aane ki probability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do barabar imkaan wale nataij hain, heads ya tails; tails aik hai: 1/2 = 50%.

book_ref.quote: Since both outcomes are equally likely, the probability of getting heads is 50% (or 1/2)

blocks.prompt:
34 Probability is calculated as:
(Probability kaise nikali jati hai?)

options.text: sab values ka jama ÷ values ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Probability = pasandeeda (favourable) nataij ki tadaad / kul nataij ki tadaad.

book_ref.quote: It helps us predict outcomes based on what we know

blocks.prompt:
35 According to the chapter, probability is used in:
(Chapter ke mutabiq probability kahan istemal hoti hai?)

options.text: mausam ki peshgoi, karobari faisle aur cricket

blocks.explanation: Probability sirf sikke ke liye nahin; mausam ki peshgoi, karobari faislon aur cricket mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used in many areas, such as predicting the weather, making business decisions, or even playing cricket

blocks.prompt:
36 The results and insights drawn from a study depend directly on the:
(Kisi study ke nataij aur insights barah-e-raast kis cheez par munhasir hain?)
blocks.explanation: Data ka mayaar (quality) aur mutabiqat (relevance) nataij par barah-e-raast asar dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The quality and relevance of the data directly impact the results and insights drawn from the study

blocks.prompt:
37 Data collection is:
(Data collection kya hai?)

options.text: data ki ghaltiyan theek karne ka amal
model ko train karne ka amal
kisi maqsad ke liye mutalliqa maloomat jama karne ka amal

blocks.explanation: Data collection kisi khaas maqsad ke liye mutalliqa maloomat jama karne ka amal hai.

book_ref.quote: Data collection refers to the process of gathering relevant information for a particular purpose

blocks.prompt:
38 Choosing the right data collection method depends on:
(Data jama karne ka sahi tareeqa chunna kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: research ka maqsad aur zaroori data ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Surveys, observations aur experiments sab ki apni khoobiyan hain; chunao research ke maqsad aur zaroori data ki qisam par hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Choosing the right method depends on the research objective and the type of data required

blocks.prompt:
39 A survey collects data by:
(Survey data kaise jama karta hai?)

options.text: logon ko un ke qudrati mahol mein dekh kar
aik variable badal kar us ka asar dekh kar
sample group se pehle se tay shuda sawal poochh kar
charts se data naqal kar ke

blocks.explanation: Survey aik sample group se pehle se tay shuda sawalat poochh kar munazzam tareeqe se data jama karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These involve asking a predefined set of questions to a sample group

blocks.prompt:
40 Which of the following is NOT one of the means of conducting a survey given in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa survey karne ka tareeqa chapter mein NAHIN diya gaya?)

options.text: customers ki baithne ki jagah dekhna

blocks.explanation: Survey online forms, telephone calls ya aamne saamne interviews se hota hai; baithne ki jagah dekhna observation hai.

book_ref.quote: Surveys can be conducted using various means such as online forms, telephone calls, or face-to-face interviews

blocks.prompt:
41 In the chapter's example, the grocery store in Islamabad gave its survey of how many questions to how many customers?
(Chapter ki misaal mein Islamabad ki grocery store ne kitne sawalon ka survey kitne customers ko diya?)
blocks.explanation: Store ne paanch sawalon ka mukhtasar survey banaya aur weekend par 50 customers ko diya.

book_ref.quote: They create a short survey consisting of five questions

blocks.prompt:
42 Observation, as a data collection method, means:
(Observation (mushahida) data jama karne ke tareeqe ke tor par kya hai?)

options.text: qudrati mahol mein dekhna ya nigrani karna

blocks.explanation: Observation mein logon ya cheezon ko un ke qudrati mahol mein dekh kar ya nigrani kar ke data jama kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Observation involves collecting data by watching or monitoring subjects in their natural environment

blocks.prompt:
43 A staff member watches which tables customers choose at lunchtime for one week. This data collection method is:
(Aik staff member aik hafta dekhta hai ke dopehar ko customers kaun si tables chunte hain. Yeh kaun sa tareeqa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baghair dakhal ke rawayya dekhna observation hai; restaurant ne is se apni seating tarteeb di.

book_ref.quote: This method is useful when researchers want to gather data on behaviors or phenomena without interference

blocks.prompt:
44 An experiment, as a data collection method, involves:
(Experiment data jama karne ke tareeqe ke tor par kya karta hai?)

options.text: aik ya zyada variables badal kar doosre par asar dekhna

blocks.explanation: Experiment mein aik ya zyada variables badal kar dekha jata hai ke doosre variable par kya asar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Experiments involve manipulating one or more variables to determine their effect on another variable

blocks.prompt:
45 Experiments are particularly useful in fields where:
(Experiments khaas tor par un shobon mein faidamand hain jahan:)

options.text: durust naap ke liye controlled mahol zaroori ho

blocks.explanation: Experiments science aur engineering mein mufeed hain jahan durust naap ke liye controlled mahol zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: This method is particularly useful in scientific and engineering fields where controlled environments are necessary

blocks.prompt:
46 In the chapter's printed-notes experiment, which variable does the teacher change between the two groups?
(Printed notes wale experiment mein teacher do groups ke darmiyan kaun sa variable badalta hai?)

options.text: talaba ko printed notes milte hain ya nahin

blocks.explanation: Aik group ko printed notes milte hain aur doosra sirf lectures par chalta hai; aik maah baad dono aik hi test dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The teacher conducts an experiment with two groups of students

blocks.prompt:
47 Data preparation includes all of the following EXCEPT:
(Data preparation mein yeh sab shamil hain SIWAYE:)

options.text: ghaltiyan hatane ke liye data saaf karna
data ko tajziye ke qabil format mein badalna

blocks.explanation: Preparation mein data saaf karna, tarteeb dena aur munasib format mein badalna shamil hai; cluster centres chunna K-means ka qadam hai.

book_ref.quote: This includes cleaning the data to remove errors or inconsistencies, organizing it in a meaningful way

blocks.prompt:
48 Where data is missing or incorrect, researchers may use techniques such as:
(Jahan data ghayab ya ghalat ho, researchers kaun si techniques istemal kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ghayab ya ghalat data ke liye interpolation ya statistical adjustments istemal ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: researchers may need to employ techniques such as interpolation or statistical adjustments to ensure accuracy

blocks.prompt:
49 Proper data preparation ensures that the analysis leads to:
(Achhi data preparation tajziye ko kis taraf le jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Achhi preparation se nataij qabil-e-aitbaar (reliable) aur durust (valid) hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Proper data preparation ensures that the analysis leads to reliable and valid results

blocks.prompt:
50 Data cleaning and transformation are needed because raw data often:
(Data cleaning aur transformation ki zaroorat kyon hoti hai?)

options.text: yeh hamesha mukammal aur durust hota hai
yeh pehle se chart hota hai
is mein koi number nahin hota
is mein ghaltiyan, missing values ya ghalat format hota hai

blocks.explanation: Khaam data mein aksar ghaltiyan, missing values ya ghalat format hota hai, jo durust nataij ke liye theek karna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Raw data often has errors, missing values, or may be in the wrong format

blocks.prompt:
51 Data cleaning means:
(Data cleaning ka kya matlab hai?)

options.text: data ke masail theek karna ya hatana

blocks.explanation: Data cleaning data ke masail, jaise ghalat entries, missing values aur duplicates, theek karna ya hatana hai.

book_ref.quote: Data cleaning means correcting or removing any problems in the data

blocks.prompt:
52 Which of these is NOT a problem that data cleaning fixes?
(In mein se kaun sa masla data cleaning theek NAHIN karti?)

options.text: tajziye ke liye naye columns banane ki zaroorat

blocks.explanation: Cleaning ghalat entries, missing values aur duplicates theek karti hai; naye columns banana transformation hai.

book_ref.quote: These problems can include incorrect entries, missing values, or duplicate data

blocks.prompt:
53 In Table 5.2, the name "Alie" is changed to "Ali" in the cleaned data. This is an example of:
(Table 5.2 mein "Alie" ko "Ali" kiya gaya. Yeh kis cheez ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghalat likha naam ghalat entry hai; cleaning use theek karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Some students may have entered their names incorrectly

blocks.prompt:
54 In Table 5.2, Sara's grade is empty in the original data. In the cleaned data her grade is:
(Table 5.2 ke asal data mein Sara ka grade khaali hai. Saaf kiye gaye data mein us ka grade kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cleaning missing grade dhoond kar data mukammal karti hai; saaf table mein Sara ka grade 75 hai.

book_ref.quote: a few grades may be missing from the records

blocks.prompt:
55 If errors in the data are not fixed, the results of the analysis will be:
(Agar data ki ghaltiyan theek na ki jayen to tajziye ke nataij kaise honge?)
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan theek na hon to nataij gumrah-kun (misleading) honge.

book_ref.quote: If these errors are not fixed, the results of the analysis will be misleading

blocks.prompt:
56 Data transformation is normally done:
(Data transformation aam tor par kab ki jati hai?)

options.text: sirf model ki jaanch ke baad

blocks.explanation: Data saaf hone ke baad use aise format mein badla jata hai jis par kaam aasan ho.

book_ref.quote: Once the data is clean, it is often necessary to transform it into a format that is easy to work with

blocks.prompt:
57 Which of the following is a data transformation task?
(In mein se kaun sa data transformation ka kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transformation mein format badalna, naye columns banana ya data ko mukhtalif tarteeb dena shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: This transformation may include converting data into different formats, creating new columns, or organizing data in a different way

blocks.prompt:
58 Removing the rows that have missing values is a suitable option when such rows are:
(Missing values wali rows hatana kab munasib hai?)

options.text: pehle se flag aur impute ho chuki hon

blocks.explanation: Missing values wali rows tab hatayi ja sakti hain jab woh bohat kam hon.

book_ref.quote: One option is to remove the rows with missing values if they are very few

blocks.prompt:
59 A school gives Sara's missing grade the class average of 82 for the time being. This method is called:
(School Sara ke missing grade ki jagah class ka average 82 laga deta hai. Is tareeqe ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Imputation mojooda data se missing value ka andaza lagati hai, yahan class ka average.

book_ref.quote: One common method is to estimate the missing value using existing data

blocks.prompt:
60 Adding a note in the dataset that Sara's grade is not available, without filling the gap, is called:
(Data mein note lagana ke Sara ka grade mojood nahin, khala bhare baghair, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flagging note laga kar missing grade ka record rakhta hai; is se shaffafiyat (transparency) rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: This method indicates that Sara's grade is not available, making analysts aware of the incomplete data

blocks.prompt:
61 The main risk of excluding Sara's record from an analysis (removal) is:
(Sara ka record tajziye se nikalne (removal) ka bara khatra kya hai?)

options.text: us ke bare mein qeemti maloomat kho dena

blocks.explanation: Removal tab theek hai jab entries kam hon, magar is mein qeemti maloomat kho jane ka khatra hai.

book_ref.quote: However, it risks losing valuable information about Sara

blocks.prompt:
62 The choice of technique for handling missing data depends on:
(Missing data ki technique ka chunao kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: data ki qisam aur missing maloomat ki miqdar

blocks.explanation: Chunao data ki qisam aur missing maloomat ki miqdar par munhasir hai.
